findings.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Tomcat 10 remains incorrectly classified, and Tomcat 7’s setup-only variant still inherits metadata collection.
1 open finding - [Complete Tomcat 10 request-parameter cleanup and trace-ID exclusion](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20564#discussion_r4264181151) · New
1 resolved since last review - [Disable metadata collection for setup-only trace-ID regression task](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20564#discussion_r4254055743)
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced

The stated Servlet/Tomcat cleanup is incomplete for the adjacent Tomcat 10 collection entries. `tomcat-10.0/javaagent/build.gradle.kts:30-32` still enables request-parameter capture for every test task, while lines 314-315 still collect the baseline and setup-only trace-ID variant. As a result, Tomcat 10 continues classifying captured request-parameter telemetry as default (and under the trace-ID label). Apply the same dedicated capture variant/default-off expectation there and stop collecting its trace-ID-only task.
